'''Chemical churners''' were devices that were used in conjunction with [[impact sifter]]s to create [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cores]] for [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] and [[Plasma generator/Legends|plasma generators]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the industrial [[planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]] produced fuel cores using chemical churners.<ref name="Death-Hunter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chemical churners appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]] adventure "[[Death-Hunter]]," written by [[Tony Russo]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[February]] [[1996]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Death-Hunter" />
